Bakers White Chocolate Mousse
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 1:33pm

Ingredients




1 pkt Baker's White Baking Chocolate (6 squares)
1 1/2 cups whipping (heavy) cream divided

Preparation

1 Microwave chocolate and 1/4 cup cream in a large microwaveable bowl on HIGH 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted, stirring halfway through heating time. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Cool 20 minutes or until room temperature, stirring occasionally. 2 Beat remaining 1 1/4 cups cream in a chilled medium bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form. DO NOT OVERBEAT. Fold 1/2 of whipped cream into chocolate mixture. Fold in remaining whipped cream just until blended. Spoon into dessert dishes. 3 Refrigerate 2 hours or until ready to serve. Garnish as desired. 4 Yield: 6 (1/2 cup) servings 5 NOTES : Melting chocolate on Top of Stove: Heat chocolate and cream in a heavy 1-quart saucepan on very low heat; stir constantly, until chocolate is just melted. Remove from heat. Pour into a large bowl. Continue as directed.
